name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 4px outer ring in #005fcc with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This ensures keyboard users see a clear, high-contrast target that meets WCAG 2.2 AA for focus visibility. The trade-off is slightly larger focus rings, which may feel bold but prioritize usability for everyone over minimalist aesthetics.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring fails on high-contrast patterned backgrounds where the white inner ring disappears into the pattern. A 2px solid ring in #005fcc alone meets WCAG 2.2 AA without the inner ring and avoids the pattern clash. Test it on a zebra-striped background to settle the argument.
